cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,ctypes,copy,json,io
sys.path[:0]=['site','submission'];ctypes.CDLL('native/libz.so.1',mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from pipeline import execute
from formats import read_request
spec={'id':'z','classes':1,'width':2,'eps':[0,1],'ratio':[0,1],'threshold':[0,1],'mode':'exact','packet_limit':2,'idle_us':0,'discovery':[],'train':[{'class':0,'values':[]}],'validation':[{'class':0,'values':[1514]}]}
x={'capacity':{'range':0,'exact':0},'releases':[spec],'blocks':[[['install','z'],['open','empty'],['close','empty'],['open','empty'],['packet','empty',0,1,1514],['packet','empty',0,0,1514],['packet','empty',1,1,1514],['packet','empty',1,1,1514],['close','empty']]]}
r=execute(read_request(io.BytesIO(json.dumps(x).encode())))
assert r['catalog']==[{'id':'z','fragments':[],'noise':[],'clusters':[],'priority':[],'backup':[[0]],'entries':0}]
assert [d['reason'] for d in r['decisions']]==['close','idle']
assert [d['seen'] for d in r['decisions']]==[0,2]
assert [d['epoch'] for d in r['decisions']]==[0,1]
print('empty discovery, empty epochs, reopen, idle precedence okay')
# Classifications do not waive later timestamp validation.
x['blocks'][0].insert(-1,['packet','empty',0,1,1])
try:execute(read_request(io.BytesIO(json.dumps(x).encode())))
except ValueError:print('post-commit timestamp regression rejected')
else:raise AssertionError()
PY
